title: Summer reset: ops heatmap + exec asks (v0.1)
content:
Purpose / one-liner:
Quick working runbook for the summer reset: align company-level OKR drafts, highlight operational hot spots (heatmap), and surface 3 targeted exec asks for the upcoming all-hands and leadership sync. This is a working doc — lots of TODOs and open questions below.

Context / why now:
- Usage and growth patterns show a trough in new paid onboarding in May; we want a compact plan to re-focus engineering/product priorities for increased reliability and continued PLG momentum through H2.
- Several cross-functional efforts need clear decision points before the next quarterly planning cycle (billing retries, dedicated capacity rollout cadence, Private deployment compliance gates).
- All-hands will be used to transparently surface trade-offs and commit to ~6 company-level priorities for the next 12 weeks.

Draft company-level Objectives (top-level, candidate):
O1: Make inference predictable for customers (latency and cost SLOs)
  - KR1: 95th pct latency SLO met for hosted API across top 3 models (baseline: 95th latency per model, reduction target 20%)
  - KR2: Reduce per-token cost (hosting) by 15% through Combine batching + cache improvements (pilot in Dedicated)
  - KR3: Publish 3 verified model+quantization profiles for common PLG workloads

O2: Grow self-serve expansion (trial -> paid)
  - KR1: Increase trial->paid conversion +10% by improving onboarding flow and usage triggers
  - KR2: Ship two plug-and-play quickstarts (vector search + chat) with telemetry hooks
  - KR3: Reduce time-to-first-successful-call (docs + SDK) by 30%

O3: Make Redwood Private enterprise-ready for regulated customers
  - KR1: Complete SOC type audit readiness checklist and KMS/HSM integration RFC
  - KR2: Finish on-prem install automation + 1 external partner validation run
  - KR3: Close 3 pilot deals for Private with signed NDAs and defined SLOs

Notes: these are deliberately concise, should be weighted (primary versus secondary) in exec review. Looking for feedback on KR measurability and who is proposing each KR owner.

Operations heatmap (working — colors described verbally):
- High priority / red: Billing reliability (in-flight): recurring billing failure spike -> affects revenue + support load. Root cause hypothesis: retry/backoff config + some edge-cases in token accounting. Impact: immediate. Owner: Finance + Platform Eng. Risk: revenue leakage.
- High priority / red: Dedicated capacity network throttling on east-region clusters: intermittent QoS regressions under burst. Owner: infra + serving-runtime. Impact: customer latency violations, can cause rollbacks.
- Medium priority / amber: Console cost dashboards missing token-level attribution for some routes. Owner: product-console. Impact: reduced ability to optimize customer cost.
- Medium priority / amber: Private onboarding docs inconsistent across regions; on-prem runbook incomplete. Owner: private-deployments + solutions-eng. Impact: sales friction.
- Low priority / green: Minor UX inconsistency in SDKs (naming + examples). Owner: developer-experience. Impact: friction but low business risk.

Suggested immediate mitigations (next 2 weeks):
- Billing: emergency triage + hotfix branch for retry/backoff; notify top 10 affected customers and offer credits. (Owner: Finance/Platform Eng)
- Dedicated: enable conservative routing fallback (region fallback to spare pool) and run stress job nightly to reproduce. (Owner: Serving Runtime + SRE)
- Console: prioritize token-attribution PR in the next sprint; temp dashboard workarounds to flag top routes. (Owner: Observability)

Three targeted exec asks (for leadership discussion / approval):
1) 6-week focused engineering reserve: approve reallocation of two cross-functional squads (approx. 10 FTE) to prioritize billing reliability AND Dedicated burst fix for 6 weeks. Rationale: short-term rework avoids longer-term churn and sales slippage. Ask: yes/no + any constraints (e.g., must maintain one feature sprint).
2) Pilot investment for Private go-to-market: greenlight $45k budget for external compliance validation and one on-prem partner engagement (paid test). Rationale: accelerates sales conversion for regulated accounts. Ask: approval of budget + sponsor (Sales/GT M).
3) All-hands narrative and resource ask: approve 90-minute all-hands slot and 3 breakout sessions; require execs to present trade-offs for each top priority. Ask: confirm speakers and approve pre-all-hands comms.

Proposed all-hands micro-agenda (90 minutes):
- 0–10': Opening + one-sentence state (CEO)
- 10–30': Product & Reliability snapshot (Head of Product + SRE): top metrics + heatmap
- 30–45': OKR roadmap: present proposed company Objectives and KRs (Product Ops)
- 45–70': Breakout sessions (3x 8–9 min)
    * Breakout A: Cost & Performance levers (batching, cache, quantization)
    * Breakout B: Private deployment readiness + compliance checklist
    * Breakout C: Trial->paid funnel experiments and telemetry
- 70–85': Exec Q&A and decision point polling (live poll on 3 exec asks)
- 85–90': Close / next steps / owners assignment

Prework for leaders (required):
- Submit a 1-slide snapshot with 3 bullets: current state, one risk, one proposed fix. Due: 7 days before all-hands.
- Populate the Decisions doc with current asks and expected trade-offs (link in linked_artifacts).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who will own KR measurement for O2 KR1 (trial->paid conversion)? Suggest: Growth + Analytics.
- Exact criteria for shipping Private pilot (what constitutes a pass vs fail?)
- Exec ask #1: can two squads be reallocated without impacting other business-critical features? Need org-level constraint list.
- Timeline: pick all-hands date (options: a) 2026-03-29 morning, b) 2026-04-02 afternoon). Which do we prefer?

Risks / escalation map:
- If billing fixes slip beyond 3 weeks -> escalate to CFO + CTO, open customer remediation plan.
- If Dedicated region fixes need hardware lead time -> consider capacity reservation for key customers as short-term mitigation.

Quick decisions I want from this doc (immediate asks for exec reviewers):
- Approve emergency reallocation of 2 squads for 6 weeks (yes/no + constraints)
- Approve $45k pilot budget for Private compliance validation (yes/no + sponsor)
- Confirm all-hands timing and approve 90-minute format (option a/b)

Notes to self (informal):
- Need to script the exec poll in Slido and coordinate results to be recorded in Town Decisions doc.
- Ping Legal about NDA template for pilot customers (Ravi).
- Collect per-model 95th latency baselines from Serving Runtime (Tom).

Appendix (quick links to artifacts to pull into final deck):
- Billing incident timeline (JIRA:OPS-4122)
- Recent Dedicated performance experiments (GH:serving-runtime/benchmarks/patch-128)
- Private onboarding checklist draft (Confluence:private/onboarding-runbook-draft)

End — this is a working draft. Please add comments inline, tag owners on specific action items, and update KRs if you have a measurement suggestion.
